column1: # Stage S8 V3 — the map engine's doll becomes the paper doll crates: its scene and picking become paper_doll_scene,
# its renderer, the doll shader and the doll readback self-check become paper_doll_renderer, each file under a name
# that says what it holds (the numbered lifecycle halves become the renderer and its frame render). The doll
# folder's README becomes the paper doll category README. Paths name the tree before the moves; the frontend
# imports the renderer directly, so the map engine keeps no doll shim.
